record.question: You have set up a manufacturing unit of cloth and fabric in an Industrial area. You have been approached by local goons who demand 'protection money' (extortion money on periodic basis). They have also stated that all units in the industrial area pay them 'protection money' What do you think is the most irrelevant action?
options: Approach the police for protection and file a complaint of extortion
Approach other unit owners and exhort them to refuse to pay protection money and jointly tackle the threat of goons
Hire guards from a security agency for protection of self and the premise
Pay the protection money and peacefully concentrate on the affairs of the manufacturing unit.
